description.en: Marsilea-inspired freshwater margin water-fern patch with creeping branched rhizome, naturally curved upright petioles and four separate fan leaflets on each frond. Modern genus basic architecture is an analogy only; original needs-specific-reference status retained, not a precise fossil species, spore structure or flowering clover reconstruction. No marine habitat or water mesh.
